scientific_integrity: The infinite proof is a direct rooted two-round Ehrenfeucht–Fraisse analysis and a ten-footprint table. Standalone finite checks reproduce and corroborate the table, but cannot replace the infinite argument. No independent scientific audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Pure uncolored loopless directed-edge language; exactly three nonempty independent parts in cyclic orientation; only quantifier rank at most three. The classification is internal to this family and does not cover counting logic, named parts or all digraphs. Equivalent unindexed historical literature may exist.
title: Ten rank-three theories of cyclically oriented complete tripartite digraphs
